signal.headline: Super Typhoon Halong forecast to make landfall near Kaohsiung within 48h
signal.body: Category 5-equivalent storm tracking toward southern Taiwan. Kaohsiung port authority announces preemptive closure for at least 5 days.

signal.headline: Fire reported at Gumi PowerCells cell line 2
signal.body: Supplier declared force majeure. Line 2 offline, preliminary restoration estimate 6-8 weeks.

signal.headline: M6.9 earthquake near Hsinchu Science Park
signal.body: Strong quake 40km from Hsinchu. Fabs executing post-seismic inspection protocols. Hsinchu Microfab and Taoyuan Sensor Labs in affected zone.

signal.headline: Curitiba Castings enters judicial restructuring
signal.body: Tier-1 castings supplier filed for court-supervised restructuring. Credit insurers have withdrawn coverage.

signal.headline: Ransomware attack disrupts Penang Optics ERP systems
signal.body: Supplier confirms ransomware incident. Order processing and outbound logistics manual; shipping confirmations delayed indefinitely.

signal.headline: New customs inspection regime at Manzanillo adds 24-48h
signal.body: Random inspection rate increased. Brokers advise adding 2 days of buffer for northbound clearance.

signal.headline: Monsoon flooding in Chennai industrial corridor
signal.body: Localized flooding, most plants operating normally. Chennai Passives reports no impact but road freight to port slowed by 1-2 days.

signal.headline: Cobalt spot price up 31% month-over-month
signal.body: Battery-grade cobalt rally driven by mine output cuts. Cell suppliers signaling 8-12% pack price increases at next quarterly negotiation.

signal.headline: Transit workers strike in Reykjavik
signal.body: City bus drivers begin open-ended industrial action. No industrial or port operations affected.

signal.headline: Shanghai berth wait times rise to 9 days
signal.body: Container backlog after week-long fog closures. Carriers quoting 7-10 day delays on trans-pacific lanes departing Shanghai through end of month.
